candidate.publisher: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation through SpecPrint
candidate.availability: paid historical master with monthly creation and weekly subscription delivery; FTP is preferred and advance payment is required
candidate.price: $2,100 per Corporate File; published weekly-subscription pricing is unresolved; listed media and shipping charges are included

observed_evidence: SDAT describes a broad historical Corporate Master File covering multiple domestic and foreign entity types, created monthly with a weekly subscription option.

SpecPrint publishes a $2,100 per-Corporate-File price and an unversioned 25-file fixed-position layout, but no separate weekly-subscription price, current code values, row sample, encoding, schema date, or compatibility guarantee.

The price page labels average weekly volume as 9,300,000 records without an as-of date; this is not safely interpretable as a unique-entity count and no compressed or uncompressed byte size is published.
The public SDAT ID and the layout's prefix-plus-16-character ID_BUS lack a published mapping, non-reuse promise, and lifecycle contract.
Address-type codes are unpublished, so principal or administrative entity addresses cannot safely be separated from resident-agent, trade-name-filer, tax, or person-linked addresses.
FTP delivery is possible, but full-versus-delta, deletion, correction, replay, checksum, unattended retrieval, and derived-publication rights remain undocumented.
required_exclusions: resident and registered agents and every registered-office or service address
trade-name filers, owners, officers, directors, managers, members and other natural-person roles and addresses
email, phone, signature and direct-contact fields
FEIN, EIN, SSN, tax, payment, financial and non-registry government identifiers; preserve only a contract-confirmed public SDAT entity key
filing images, documents, comments and narrative or free-text fields
states.strongest_bounded_next_action: Ask SDAT and SpecPrint for current unsigned terms, the data dictionary and a header-only person-free sample, identifier and address codebooks, current aggregate size, baseline/update/change/checksum contract, unattended FTP support, and written retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication and redistribution rights. Do not purchase, obtain credentials, request rows, scrape the portal, or implement a connector first.

candidate.publisher: Missouri Secretary of State, Business Services Division, Corporations Unit
candidate.availability: an official report confirms implementation, but the current service catalog publishes no bulk order route, delivery mechanism, agreement, or current technical contract
candidate.price: Unknown; no current product price is published

observed_evidence: One official report says corporate bulk downloads were implemented in November 2022; a separate report aggregates bulk-data revenue with filings and copies and does not attribute sales to this corporate product. The current SOS catalog exposes no bulk route, price, terms, or delivery mechanism.
The registry covers many legal-entity forms but excludes important operating-business universes, and exact bulk inclusion of statuses, history, and fictitious names is unpublished.
Charter No. is only a candidate key because global uniqueness, non-reuse, lifecycle, and platform-continuity guarantees are absent; expired fictitious names receive new numbers.
Registry standing is legal and filing status rather than proof of commercial operation, while registered-agent and registered-office fields are service-of-process roles.
No public schema, sample, count, byte size, delivery/change contract, automation allowance, or product-specific downstream-use license was located.

candidate.price: $8,000 one-time, or $9,500 baseline-plus-subscription eligibility plus $500 for each selected monthly update

observed_evidence: INBiz documents an account-gated monthly full file on USB and downloadable differential updates, with material purchase costs but no unattended acquisition contract.
The source covers SOS-registered legal entities rather than all operating businesses, and its active-business aggregate is not a bulk row count.
Business ID is only a candidate key because the bulk schema and lifecycle across merger, conversion, reinstatement, dissolution, and platform migration are unpublished.
Differential updates lack published deletion, tombstone, ordering, watermark, correction, replay, baseline-compatibility, checksum, and control-total semantics.

Principal-office evidence is administrative only, 2026 privacy changes permit withheld residential or CMRA addresses, and commercial transformation, geocoding, publication, and redistribution rights remain unresolved.

candidate.publisher: South Carolina Secretary of State through South Carolina Interactive / SC.gov
candidate.availability: paid monthly CSV archives pushed to a subscriber-provided FTP endpoint on the fifth of each month; signed SCI registration, ACH Auto Pay, and state-fiscal-year access required
candidate.price: $12,000 per state fiscal year plus the $125 annual SCI subscription; no proration or refunds

observed_evidence: The current subscriber agreement defines monthly CSV delivery, filenames, and price, but requires a signed registration, annual payment, ACH Auto Pay, and subscriber-supplied FTP credentials.
The phrase all public information associated with Corporation filings is not an exact schema, sample, aggregate size, type/status dictionary, or current legal-entity scope contract.
Secretary of State registration spans several entity forms but excludes sole proprietorships and general partnerships, and a current stable source-identifier lifecycle is unpublished.
The portal explicitly says good standing means not dissolved in SOS records and does not mean currently operating; registered office may be the agent's business office rather than an establishment.
Baseline-versus-delta, corrections, deletions, replay, checksums, unattended use, retention, geocoding, derived publication, and redistribution rights are undocumented.
